notes: Which provider and model runs each model stage of the deep-review pipeline.
Pick a profile with DEEP_REVIEW_PROFILE=<name> (default: the `default` key), or route one stage with DEEP_REVIEW_<STAGE>=<provider>:<model>, e.g. DEEP_REVIEW_OBSERVE=gemini:gemini-3.8-flash.
Gemini routes may set thinking (thinkingLevel) and mediaResolution; both are part of the response cache key.

Stages: observe (blind demo-frame description), generate (draft and its repairs), verify (independent check of demonstrated and foundInCode claims), investigate (the evidence dossier's narrow Gemini investigators; the `dossier` profile runs only observe and investigate).
Every profile other than the default writes its model-dependent outputs to .cache/<id>/runs/<profile>/ so an A/B run never overwrites the baseline.
Prices are USD per million tokens at list price without promotions or credits. Gemini 3.6-3.8 Flash are half price until 2026-12-31; the 2027 list price is used here. Checked 2026-09-26.
